title: 第14章 松松和阿妈
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
【等会儿，让我捋捋】

    扁扁的光团脑袋上冒出一团黑线，对这番话有点没理清。

    它掰着数据变成的手指头捋了捋。

    【城主你是真千金，这钱原本就是你的，现在拿了只是物归原主，花家本来也该给你钱】

    【而且花岁岁是坏人，她的钱也不干净，我卷了她的钱到城主手里，我们用来建设古城得到声望值，从而让华夏文化发光发热】

    小助的声音越来越大，每说一句古城的发展，声音里便带着些许激动。

    是的，没错，城主说得对。

    花岁岁不是好人，她抢了城主的身份和地位，这些钱原本就是城主的。

    它帮着把钱从花岁岁的账户上转到城主账户，只是左手倒右手，也是物归原主。

    它没错，这笔钱也不是赃款！！！

    小助悬着的心蓦然放下，身体也变圆了，重新飘在了屏幕中间，变成一个火柴人重重点头。

    【城主，你没错，这钱不是赃款，它干干净净】

    【你是花家的血脉，拥有这笔钱的决策权】

    花期眼角弯了弯，手指按住屏幕的光团上，拖着它的身体原地转了转。

    “这才对嘛小助，你能这么想我很欣慰，我们的人生目标只有发展古城宣传华夏文化，任何对古城有利的都是好事。”

    【是的城主，我们一切都是为了古城发展】

    小助身体一挺，对这话十分自豪。

    它要建设古城复苏文化，要把古城打造成星际第一城，还要和城主一起走上巅峰。

    更要对主系统证明它才不是孬种！

    但是，它是不是忘了什么来着？

    ......

    松松一直生活在茫茫林海，从出生到长大便没离开过森林。

    每日最平凡的日子，便是睡醒——找食物——找阿妈。

    这次突然到了古城，是松松鼠生中第一次离开。
content_en:
[Wait a minute, let me figure it out]

    A black line appeared on the flat head of the ball of light, and he was a little confused about these words.

    It licked its fingers that turned into data.

    [City Lord, you are a real daughter. This money was originally yours. Now that you have taken it, it just returns to the original owner. The Hua family should have given you the money as well.]

    [Furthermore, Hua Suisui is a bad person, and her money is not clean. I took her money and gave it to the city lord. We will use it to build the ancient city to gain reputation points, so that Chinese culture can shine.]

    Xiaosuke's voice became louder and louder, with a little excitement in his voice every time he said something about the development of the ancient city.

    Yes, that's right, the city lord is right.

    Hua Suisui is not a good person. She robbed the city lord of his identity and status. The money originally belonged to the city lord.

    It helped transfer the money from Hua Suisui's account to the city owner's account. It just transferred the money from the left hand to the right hand, and it also returned the money to the original owner.

    It's true, and the money is not stolen money! ! !

    Xiaosuke's hanging heart suddenly dropped, his body became rounder, and he floated in the middle of the screen again, turning into a stick figure and nodding heavily.

    [City Lord, you are right, this money is not stolen money, it is clean]

    [You are a bloodline of the Hua family and have the decision-making power over this money]

    The corners of Hua Qi's eyes curled up, her fingers pressed on the light ball on the screen, and she dragged its body around.

    "That's right, Xiaosuke. I'm very happy that you think so. Our goal in life is to develop the ancient city and promote Chinese culture. Anything that is beneficial to the ancient city is a good thing."

    [Yes City Lord, we are doing everything for the development of the ancient city]

    Xiaosuke straightened up, very proud of these words.

    It wants to build the ancient city to revive culture, build the ancient city into the first city in the interstellar world, and reach the top together with the city owner.

    We need to prove to the main system that it is not a coward!

    But has it forgotten something?

    ...

    Songsong has always lived in the vast forest, and has never left the forest since he was born.

    The most ordinary day every day is waking up - looking for food - looking for grandma.

    This time I suddenly arrived at the ancient city. It was the first time in my life that Song Squirrel had left.
